units.source_text: 古代风俗：暮春旅行必带币袋，沿路供献道祖神，以祈旅途平安。

en.t: According to ancient custom, travelers in late spring always carried a coin-offering bag and made offerings to the roadside guardian deities along the way, praying for a safe journey.

units.source_text: 币袋是一只疏网袋，内装各种色彩的布帛或纸片，袋外看见各种色彩。

en.t: The coin-offering bag was a loosely woven net bag filled with cloth or paper scraps of many colors, so that various colors could be seen from outside the bag.

units.source_text: 今以此比拟帘内参差人影。

en.t: Here this image is used as a comparison for the unevenly glimpsed figures behind the curtain.
